mutants.name: keyword-case
mutants.change: Make keyword recognition case-sensitive.

mutants.name: unicode-space
mutants.change: Accept all Python Unicode whitespace between tokens.

mutants.name: split-symbol
mutants.change: Split longest two-character symbols into single characters.

mutants.name: spaced-param
mutants.change: Permit ASCII whitespace between dollar and the parameter name.

mutants.name: character-offset
mutants.change: Use Unicode character indices rather than UTF-8 byte positions.

mutants.name: eof-offset
mutants.change: Report EOF one byte too early.

mutants.name: unsupported-syntax
mutants.change: Classify excluded syntax as Syntax.

mutants.name: syntax-unsupported
mutants.change: Classify malformed supported syntax as Unsupported.

mutants.name: parameter-syntax
mutants.change: Classify parameter-use errors as Syntax.

mutants.name: limit-parameter
mutants.change: Classify fixed-cap failures as Parameter.

mutants.name: allow-reserved
mutants.change: Permit reserved bare variables and aliases.

mutants.name: reserve-names
mutants.change: Apply reserved-word restrictions to model names.

mutants.name: reserve-params
mutants.change: Apply reserved-word restrictions to dollar parameters.

mutants.name: allow-multi-match
mutants.change: Consume and ignore a second comma-separated MATCH node.

mutants.name: allow-chain
mutants.change: Consume and ignore one extra chained relationship.

mutants.name: allow-unanchored
mutants.change: Remove the first-node anchor requirement on relationship MATCH.

mutants.name: allow-path-node
mutants.change: Permit path declaration on a node-only MATCH.

mutants.name: allow-rel-hops
mutants.change: Permit relationship variable declarations on starred patterns.

mutants.name: allow-anchor-hops
mutants.change: Permit relationship anchors together with a star.

mutants.name: allow-write-hops
mutants.change: Permit variable-length write MATCH.

mutants.name: allow-write-asof
mutants.change: Permit AS OF on a write statement.

mutants.name: allow-redeclare
mutants.change: Suppress duplicate binding declaration errors.

mutants.name: allow-future
mutants.change: Permit WHERE to refer to undeclared future variables.

mutants.name: allow-edge-label
mutants.change: Permit label changes on a relationship.

mutants.name: allow-detach-edge
mutants.change: Permit DETACH DELETE on a relationship.

mutants.name: allow-duplicate-label
mutants.change: Ignore duplicate labels in a node pattern.

mutants.name: allow-duplicate-map
mutants.change: Ignore duplicate property map keys.

mutants.name: allow-duplicate-patch
mutants.change: Ignore duplicate property or label patch/removal targets.

mutants.name: allow-duplicate-column
mutants.change: Ignore duplicate RETURN column names.

mutants.name: allow-unresolved
mutants.change: Permit unresolved variable references.

mutants.name: allow-entity-sort
mutants.change: Permit ORDER BY on a projected whole entity.

mutants.name: allow-unprojected-sort
mutants.change: Permit ORDER BY on an unprojected alias.

mutants.name: allow-unaliased-sort
mutants.change: Permit sorting an unaliased field by a quoted dotted column name.

mutants.name: allow-hop-zero
mutants.change: Accept a zero upper hop bound.

mutants.name: allow-hop-leading-zero
mutants.change: Accept leading zeros in an upper hop bound.

mutants.name: raise-hop-cap
mutants.change: Raise the dialect hop cap from 4 to 5.

mutants.name: lower-hop-cap
mutants.change: Lower the dialect hop cap from 4 to 3.

mutants.name: raise-byte-cap
mutants.change: Raise the statement byte cap from 16384 to 16385.

mutants.name: lower-byte-cap
mutants.change: Lower the statement byte cap from 16384 to 16383.

mutants.name: raise-token-cap
mutants.change: Raise the token cap from 1024 to 1025.

mutants.name: lower-token-cap
mutants.change: Lower the token cap from 1024 to 1023.

mutants.name: raise-depth-cap
mutants.change: Raise the nested-parenthesis cap from 16 to 17.

mutants.name: lower-depth-cap
mutants.change: Lower the nested-parenthesis cap from 16 to 15.

mutants.name: raise-predicate-cap
mutants.change: Raise the atomic predicate cap from 64 to 65.

mutants.name: lower-predicate-cap
mutants.change: Lower the atomic predicate cap from 64 to 63.

mutants.name: raise-param-count
mutants.change: Raise the distinct-parameter cap from 64 to 65.

mutants.name: lower-param-count
mutants.change: Lower the distinct-parameter cap from 64 to 63.

mutants.name: raise-param-name
mutants.change: Raise the parameter-name cap from 256 to 257 bytes.

mutants.name: lower-param-name
mutants.change: Lower the parameter-name cap from 256 to 255 bytes.

mutants.name: raise-param-bytes
mutants.change: Raise the metadata encoding cap from 65536 to 65537 bytes.

mutants.name: lower-param-bytes
mutants.change: Lower the metadata encoding cap from 65536 to 65535 bytes.

mutants.name: allow-missing
mutants.change: Skip missing parameter reference errors.

mutants.name: allow-unused
mutants.change: Skip unused parameter errors.

mutants.name: allow-key-type
mutants.change: Remove KEY's String requirement.

mutants.name: allow-id-type
mutants.change: Remove ID's nonnegative Integer requirement.

mutants.name: allow-skip-type
mutants.change: Remove SKIP's nonnegative Integer requirement.

mutants.name: allow-limit-type
mutants.change: Remove LIMIT's nonnegative Integer requirement.

mutants.name: allow-asof-type
mutants.change: Remove AS OF's Integer requirement.

mutants.name: allow-duplicate-params
mutants.change: Discard earlier duplicate parameter-map entries.

mutants.name: allow-eof-tail
mutants.change: Accept a supported prefix without consuming EOF.

mutants.name: allow-caller-hop
mutants.change: Ignore the caller max_hops constraint after dialect hop validation.

mutants.name: reject-empty-key
mutants.change: Reintroduce planning rejection of an empty String KEY.

mutants.name: type-first-name-offset
mutants.change: Point type errors at the name's first reference rather than the first incompatible role.

read_mutants.name: read-reverse-direction
read_mutants.change: Reverse incoming/outgoing expansions.

read_mutants.name: read-drop-label
read_mutants.change: Ignore node label predicates.

read_mutants.name: read-drop-type
read_mutants.change: Ignore relationship type alternatives.

read_mutants.name: read-repeat-edge
read_mutants.change: Permit one repeated physical edge per trail.

read_mutants.name: read-double-loop
read_mutants.change: Emit an either-direction self-loop twice per expansion.

read_mutants.name: read-dedup-endpoints
read_mutants.change: Collapse distinct paths sharing an endpoint.

read_mutants.name: read-coerce-int
read_mutants.change: Compare integers through binary64 and allow numeric-tag equality.

read_mutants.name: read-bool-int
read_mutants.change: Use Boolean-as-Integer equality.

read_mutants.name: read-not-unknown
read_mutants.change: Treat unknown as false under NOT.

read_mutants.name: read-reverse-null
read_mutants.change: Place null first in ascending sort.

read_mutants.name: read-reverse-tie
read_mutants.change: Reverse the final canonical tie-break.

read_mutants.name: read-limit-first
read_mutants.change: Apply LIMIT before ORDER BY.

read_mutants.name: read-parameter-text
read_mutants.change: Treat query-looking parameter content as a successful predicate.

read_mutants.name: read-ttl-inclusive
read_mutants.change: Keep entities visible at C equal to expiry.

read_mutants.name: read-from-exclusive
read_mutants.change: Exclude the temporal segment's lower endpoint.

read_mutants.name: read-sample-clock
read_mutants.change: Use a later hypothetical TTL sample instead of captured C.

read_mutants.name: read-short-and
read_mutants.change: Short-circuit false AND and hide the right comparison error.

read_mutants.name: read-short-or
read_mutants.change: Short-circuit true OR and hide the right comparison error.

read_mutants.name: read-last-edge-predicate
read_mutants.change: Apply edge property predicates only at the last hop.

read_mutants.name: read-intermediate-endpoint
read_mutants.change: Apply endpoint predicates to intermediate nodes.

read_mutants.name: read-skip-first
read_mutants.change: Apply SKIP before ORDER BY.

read_mutants.name: read-casefold
read_mutants.change: Case-fold scalar string comparisons.

read_mutants.name: read-signed-zero
read_mutants.change: Treat opposite Float signed zeros as unequal.

read_mutants.name: read-geo-latitude
read_mutants.change: Compare GeoPoint latitude only.

read_mutants.name: read-is-not-null
read_mutants.change: Invert IS NOT NULL.

read_mutants.name: read-to-inclusive
read_mutants.change: Include the temporal upper endpoint.

read_mutants.name: read-hide-legacy
read_mutants.change: Hide legacy all-time edges under AS OF.

read_mutants.name: read-expired-endpoint
read_mutants.change: Traverse an edge with an expired endpoint.

read_mutants.name: read-default-time-zero
read_mutants.change: Use zero instead of captured C for default T.

read_mutants.name: read-visited-per-path
read_mutants.change: Count repeated-node visits rather than distinct node IDs.

read_mutants.name: read-output-per-row
read_mutants.change: Count entity occurrences rather than distinct output IDs.

read_mutants.name: read-distinct-path-cap
read_mutants.change: Count distinct paths rather than path occurrences.

read_mutants.name: read-label-or
read_mutants.change: Use disjunctive labels instead of conjunctive labels.

read_mutants.name: read-map-or
read_mutants.change: Use disjunctive map equalities instead of conjunction.

read_mutants.name: read-property-identity
read_mutants.change: Resolve id/key/revision as pseudo-fields in predicates.

read_mutants.name: read-sort-rank
read_mutants.change: Swap Integer and Float sort ranks.

read_mutants.name: read-desc-null
read_mutants.change: Do not reverse null placement under DESC.

read_mutants.name: read-ignore-edge-anchor
read_mutants.change: Ignore KEY/ID on relationship patterns.

read_mutants.name: read-default-order
read_mutants.change: Reverse default canonical result order.

read_mutants.name: read-scan-desc
read_mutants.change: Scan node IDs descending.

read_mutants.name: read-reset-work
read_mutants.change: Reset work accounting before RETURN.

read_mutants.name: read-no-cancel-sort
read_mutants.change: Skip cancellation/deadline checks during sorting.

read_mutants.name: read-no-check-64
read_mutants.change: Skip the mandated interval check at unit64.

read_mutants.name: read-clamp-limits
read_mutants.change: Clamp caller values above ceilings instead of refusing.

read_mutants.name: read-zero-output
read_mutants.change: Replace legal zero entity caps with defaults.

read_mutants.name: read-zero-return
read_mutants.change: Replace legal zero returned-row cap with default.

read_mutants.name: read-drop-path-nodes
read_mutants.change: Omit nodes nested in paths from output accounting.

read_mutants.name: read-drop-path-edges
read_mutants.change: Omit edges nested in paths from output accounting.

read_mutants.name: read-ignore-scratch
read_mutants.change: Do not charge owned scratch buffers.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-visited
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess distinct visited node.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-edges
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess adjacency examination.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-degree
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess adjacency in an expansion.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-bindings
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess materialized binding row.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-rows
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess final returned row.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-work
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess combined work unit.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-output-nodes
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess distinct output node.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-output-edges
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess distinct output edge.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-output-paths
read_mutants.change: Allow one excess path occurrence.

read_mutants.name: read-cap-deadline
read_mutants.change: Allow elapsed time equal to the deadline.

read_mutants.name: read-no-check-before
read_mutants.change: Remove the before-work cancellation/deadline checkpoint.

read_mutants.name: read-no-scan-work
read_mutants.change: Do not charge unanchored start-node scans.

read_mutants.name: read-live-target-only
read_mutants.change: Check edge target expiry but ignore source expiry.

read_mutants.name: read-allow-time-overflow
read_mutants.change: Accept default temporal instant 2**63, one above signed i64.

read_mutants.name: read-no-order-work
read_mutants.change: Do not charge ORDER BY comparisons.

read_mutants.name: read-no-canonical-work
read_mutants.change: Do not charge canonical row comparisons.

read_mutants.name: read-no-frontier-insert-work
read_mutants.change: Do not charge frontier insertions, including the initial frontier entry.

read_mutants.name: read-no-adjacency-work
read_mutants.change: Do not charge examined adjacency, including type-filtered edges.

read_mutants.name: read-no-map-work
read_mutants.change: Do not charge inline property-map predicates.

read_mutants.name: read-no-frontier-pop-work
read_mutants.change: Do not charge frontier pops, including the initial frontier entry.

read_mutants.name: read-allow-empty-key
read_mutants.change: Skip execution-time validation of empty String KEY.
